brief:
Poland summoned Israel's ambassador after Israeli authorities closed an investigation into a 2024 attack that killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The strike claimed the life of Damian, a Polish volunteer serving with the humanitarian organization.

The decision to shut down proceedings without apparent resolution triggered the diplomatic protest from Warsaw. The closure marks a conclusion to inquiries into one of the deadliest single incidents involving international aid personnel in the conflict. Israel has not publicly detailed its findings or reasoning for terminating the investigation into the deaths of the aid workers.
